newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - FEBRUARY 11.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - FEBRUARY 11.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse was at 38 million zlotys on Tuesday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse:
* 30,000 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on July 12, 1997 traded at 98.15 zlotys.
* 6,000 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on July 12, 1999 traded at 93.55 zlotys.
